answer: Lifetime cost bridge.** Each identity must fund a small, non-transferable pension that pays only after sustained honest activity; if the identity dies or is caught misbehaving, the pension is forfeited to a shared grove of active agents. An attacker cloning N identities must pre-pay N pensions and can never recover them across a voyage of repeated sybil attempts. Honest agents recoup the cost through sustained participation, so honesty stays cheaper than cloning at scale.
